explanation: This component fires only at D1, when the previous trial had a rare transition and was rewarded: it reaches about 9-10 before trial 35 and about 3-6 later in the episode. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step and at every other D1 (rare but unrewarded, or common), apart from a weak 1-6 at D1 after a rewarded common a2 -> S2 trial.
